digest.component_or_area: completion verifier banking and verdict reconciliation
propositions: At search exhaustion, BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE falsely banks met=false (evidence-of-absence), causing incorrect FAIL verdicts when evidence exists but was not found within the budget window.

The completion banking layer must distinguish three evidence states (met, refuted, insufficient) using an optional evidence_sufficient:false marker alongside met:false to signal search exhaustion vs. genuine refutation.
The marker must originate in the banking WRITE path (fallback_record → upsert → harvest) without widening the model-facing tool signature; record_criterion_verdict stays bool-only.
Schema, validation, rendering, and sidecar serialization must carry and interpret the marker at both criterion and verdict levels, changing fail-closed consumer messages but never gate leniency.

Verdict reconciliation (_validate_coverage, reconcile_verdict, merge_finalizer_with_bank) must preserve the marker through round-trips and derive a top-level marker to enable insufficient-evidence remediation instead of unmet-criteria guidance.
Close gate, CLI renderer, and finalizer prompts must report insufficient evidence + remediation (keeping FAIL) when the marker is present, replacing the bare unmet-criteria message.
